LanguageData.RPS.ExitSuitDesc: Climb out of the {0} and leave it standing here. Warcasket weapons can only be held inside a suit, so they are left with it.
LanguageData.RPS.CannotEnterNotAdult: {0} is too small for a power suit
LanguageData.RPS.CannotEnterAlreadyPiloting: {0} is already in a power suit
LanguageData.RPS.SwitchArmDesc: Switch which of the suit's two gun arms is firing.
LanguageData.RPS.ArmGunFitted: the suit's gun arm is the pilot's weapon
LanguageData.RPS.PowerGizmoDesc: The suit's power cells drain while it is piloted, and faster with the shield up or after a jump. When they run dry the servos stop and the pilot can barely move. Leave the suit standing next to a powered suit charging rack to recharge it.
LanguageData.RPS.ShieldToggleDesc: When on, the shield generator raises a shield bubble whenever the suit stands still for a moment. It absorbs every kind of damage and draws on the cells while it is up. Turn it off to save power.
LanguageData.RPS.NoTextiles: needs a stack of at least {0} textiles
LanguageData.RPS.ClimbOutHereDesc: Climb out and leave the suit standing here, ready for anyone to climb back in. No maintenance bay needed.
LanguageData.RPS.NoRoomForSuit: No room to leave a suit standing here
